note: Current five-event contract, updated by T63. Runnable first-party collector and local authorized-report importers exist. Production GitHub Pages collection is OFF. A sandbox preview/test is not production traffic. No device queue, conversion inference or fabricated performance rows. Original plans and implementation history are retained in Git.

principles.rule: The counter stores no reader identifier, cookie, IP/UA field, raw referrer or per-user reporting ID.
principles.why: Amazon's Participation Requirements forbid associating a sub-tag or reporting ID with a specific end user (R-08 in ledger/compliance.json; S02 in ledger/sources.json). A design that cannot do that even if asked is stronger than a policy that says not to.

principles.rule: Measure the page and the link, never the person.
principles.why: Daily page/link counters are descriptive event aggregates, not people or eligible sessions. Authorized account-level orders remain separate and cannot be assigned to individual pages or queries.

principles.rule: Publish no traffic, conversion or income expectation, and no forecast.
principles.why: The Operating Agreement states that Amazon makes no representation or warranty regarding the amount of traffic or commission income an Associate can expect (S58). A projection on this site would present as knowledge exactly what that clause disclaims. The layer records what happened; it never prints what will.

principles.rule: Every event has a stated decision it supports, or it is not collected.
principles.why: Measurement without a decision is cost with no benefit. This file therefore lists the decision beside each event, and the gate refuses an event with no decision.

principles.rule: Search measurement must not route visitors straight to Amazon.
principles.why: Search results, paid or unpaid, must send users to the site and not directly or indirectly to an Amazon Site (S51). Any Search Console or paid-search plan is constrained by that.

events.name: page_view
events.persistence: Self-hosted SQLite daily aggregates only when a first-party host is active; Pages configuration OFF.
events.fires_on: Visible registered page load, at most once per load.
deliberately_not_collected: raw URLs, query strings, IP/user-agent fields
per-customer purchase data or inferred conversions
events.decides: Compare observed page-load and outbound-click counts; no unique reader, eligible session or causal conclusion.
events.blocked_by: Permanent owner-controlled hosting, TLS, persistence/log/privacy review; Pages cannot accept POST.

events.name: product_link_click
events.persistence: Self-hosted SQLite daily aggregates only when a first-party host is active; Pages configuration OFF.
events.fires_on: Trusted primary or middle click on a marked, tagged, direct Amazon product link.
deliberately_not_collected: raw URLs, query strings, IP/user-agent fields
per-customer purchase data or inferred conversions
events.decides: Compare daily page/product outbound activity. More clicks do not establish more orders or profitability.
events.blocked_by: Permanent owner-controlled hosting, TLS, persistence/log/privacy review; Pages cannot accept POST.

events.name: disclosure_view
events.persistence: Self-hosted SQLite daily aggregates only when a first-party host is active; Pages configuration OFF.
events.fires_on: Actual disclosure-strip IntersectionObserver intersection. No observer means unknown.
deliberately_not_collected: raw URLs, query strings, IP/user-agent fields
per-customer purchase data or inferred conversions
events.decides: Check aggregate disclosure intersections alongside visual/structural checks. No per-person sequence, majority-of-sessions or compliance proof is reconstructable.
events.blocked_by: Permanent owner-controlled hosting, TLS, persistence/log/privacy review; Pages cannot accept POST.

events.name: conversion_import
events.fires_on: Local import of a normalized authorized Associates aggregate export. No browser conversion event.
deliberately_not_collected: raw URLs, query strings, IP/user-agent fields
per-customer purchase data or inferred conversions
events.decides: Inspect reported account-level orders without inferring attribution to a page/query or calculating a revenue forecast.
events.blocked_by: Authorized Associates export and enrolled tracking-report evidence unavailable.
events.persistence: Validated local report aggregates and hash/date provenance; no real report imported.

events.name: search_query_import
events.fires_on: Local import of a normalized authorized Search Console export.
deliberately_not_collected: any query outside the reviewed non-personal topic allowlist; names cannot be safely screened by regex alone
events.decides: Review actual reported buyer queries and arrivals. No report means topic demand remains unknown.
events.blocked_by: Authorized verified Search Console property/export unavailable.
events.persistence: Validated local report aggregates and hash/date provenance; no real report imported.

decisions_enabled.rule: Compare descriptive daily page/load and outbound counts, then review page intent and sources; counts alone do not diagnose causality.

decisions_enabled.decision: Which of the five product formats to investigate next
decisions_enabled.rule: Use reported daily product-link counts as one descriptive signal, not proof of demand, profitability or a winning product.

decisions_enabled.decision: Whether the disclosure is placed well enough
decisions_enabled.rule: Use structural and viewport tests plus actual intersection counts. No session identifier exists, so individual disclosure/click ordering or a session majority cannot be calculated.

decisions_enabled.decision: Whether to change the content strategy at all
decisions_enabled.rule: Requires authorized orders plus scope-aware interpretation. Do not infer page-level sales or publish a forecast from absent or account-level data.

privacy_and_consent.position: Engineering safeguards: aggregate daily counts, no reader identifiers, DNT/GPC honored, no browser queue or retries, 90-day retention. Pages collection remains disabled.
privacy_and_consent.what_is_asserted: Only the described implementation. Infrastructure sees network metadata; proxy/CDN logging and backups require explicit review. Optional operator proposal preferences use localStorage only on explicit selection and are not counter data.
privacy_and_consent.what_is_not_asserted: No blanket GDPR/ePrivacy/CCPA compliance or consent exemption is claimed. Operator identity, jurisdiction, privacy contact and production hosting must be reviewed.

open_items.item: Writable collector implemented and runnable in a sandbox; permanent authorized hosting is absent. Pages stays OFF.
90-day expiry implemented; daily pruning, backup expiry and infrastructure logging configuration remain deployment requirements.
Trusted browser interactions, strict dimensions and a global request budget reduce noise but are not bot detection. Counts are not unique humans.
Only authorized Associates reports establish reported orders. No report supplied; no page/query attribution inferred.
Verified Search Console property and reviewed authorized query export unavailable.

history.note: Original five-event proposal; previous wording remains in Git history.
Earlier implementation queued browser-only events and described them as LIVE. Superseded: a queue without a writable host is not persistent measurement.
